info.name: Sozuri API
info.description:
Every customer API of Sozuri: SMS, WhatsApp (QR code and official), voice, premium SMS, contacts, payments, airtime and workflows, plus requests that test your own webhook receiver.

## Set up
1. Open this collection's **Variables** tab.
2. Set **`apiKey`** (Manage API → API Credentials) and **`project`** (your project's exact name). Every request sends both: the key as a Bearer token, the name as `project`.
3. Fill in the variables for what you will try: `smsFrom` (a registered sender ID), the `…To` numbers, and so on. Each variable says what it is for.

## What to expect
- **SMS and premium SMS refuse with HTTP 200** and a message starting `Error.` (SMS) or `"status": "error"` (premium). Their test tabs check the body, not only the status.
- WhatsApp, voice and contacts refuse with a 4xx status.
- A wrong key or project name is `401 AUTHENTICATION_FAILED`; a missing or malformed field is `422 VALIDATION_FAILED` with `errors`.
- Every request sends `Accept: application/json`.

The older `POST /api/v1/messaging/whatsapp` is not included: it is retired, and its replacement is **WhatsApp → Send a text** (`POST /api/v1/whatsapp/messages`).

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs

item.name: Start here
item.description:
Two requests to run first. **Check your credentials** proves your `apiKey` and `project` variables are right without sending anything. **Platform status** needs no key.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/authentication

query.description: Your project's name. The key and the name together are the credential.

request.description:
Checks your API key and project name. Sends nothing and costs nothing.

- **200** `{"messageData":{"message":"Success. Project found."}}`
- **401** `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED`: the key or the project name is wrong (the name must match exactly).

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/authentication#auth-check

response.name: Wrong key or project name

request.description:
Overall platform health, each network and each component. No API key needed.

`status` is `operational`, `degraded` or `down`. HTTP 200 for operational or degraded, 503 when down.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/status

item.name: SMS
item.description:
Send SMS. `/v1/messaging` answers `sent` / `11` for an accepted recipient; `/v2/messaging` answers `accepted` / `11`, or `scheduled` / `14`. Both answer `unsupported_number` / `12` and `sender_not_registered` / `24`.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/text

request.description:
Send one message to one or more numbers.

| Field | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | yes | Your project's name. |
| `from` | yes | A sender ID registered on your project, matched exactly (case included) per network and type. A recipient on a network where it is not registered comes back `sender_not_registered` / `24` and is not charged. |
| `to` | yes | One or more numbers, comma-separated. Each becomes `254` + its last 9 digits; duplicates and opted-out numbers are removed. |
| `message` | yes | Up to 160 characters a part. Characters outside letters, digits, spaces and `- / { } ^ | ( ) + < > [ ] $ " ' : ; . = , & @ * # ! % ? _` are removed. |
| `type` | yes | `transactional` or `promotional`, in lower case. |
| `campaign` | no | Groups the messages in reports. Default `default`. |
| `sendAt` | no | `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`, East Africa Time. More than 2 minutes ahead schedules the send. |
| `optout` | no | Any value appends ` STOP*456*9*5#`. |

**Refusals are HTTP 200** with `{"messageData":{"message":"Error. …"}}`, and nothing is sent or charged. The test tab of this request checks for that.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/text

body.raw:
{
    "project": "{{project}}",
    "from": "{{smsFrom}}",
    "to": "{{smsTo}}",
    "message": "Your order A-1042 is ready for collection.",
    "type": "transactional"
}

exec: pm.test('Accepted, not refused (a refusal is HTTP 200 with messageData.message starting "Error.")', () => {

item.name: WhatsApp
item.description:
Send and look things up on both WhatsApp channels: a number linked by QR code, and official numbers connected through Meta. `POST /v1/whatsapp/messages` sends on either; the two channel-specific endpoints are in their own folders.

Which channel can do what: https://sozuri.net/docs/whatsapp-channels

Each send saves the new message's id in `{{waMessageId}}`, ready for **Reply to a message** and **React to a message**.

query.description: Optional. Also says whether this customer's 24-hour window is open on each official number.

request.description:
Your WhatsApp channels, whether each is connected, and what each can send (`sends`, `freeForm`, `templates`).

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/whatsapp-official#meta-channels

A text message. The QR-code channel sends free-form text any time; the official channel only within 24 hours of the customer's last message.

Sozuri picks the channel (QR code or official) unless you pass `channel` (`qr` or `meta`) or `from` (one of your numbers). The response says which: `channel` and `routed`.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/whatsapp-official#meta-send

response.name: Outside the 24-hour window (official channel)

request.description:
An image from a public HTTPS link, with an optional caption.

Sozuri picks the channel (QR code or official) unless you pass `channel` (`qr` or `meta`) or `from` (one of your numbers). The response says which: `channel` and `routed`.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/whatsapp-official#meta-send

A document from a public HTTPS link.

Sozuri picks the channel (QR code or official) unless you pass `channel` (`qr` or `meta`) or `from` (one of your numbers). The response says which: `channel` and `routed`.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/whatsapp-official#meta-send

An OGG/OPUS file sent as a voice note (`voice: true`). Without `voice`, it is an audio file.

Sozuri picks the channel (QR code or official) unless you pass `channel` (`qr` or `meta`) or `from` (one of your numbers). The response says which: `channel` and `routed`.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/whatsapp-official#meta-send

A map pin. `latitude` and `longitude` must be JSON numbers, not strings.

Sozuri picks the channel (QR code or official) unless you pass `channel` (`qr` or `meta`) or `from` (one of your numbers). The response says which: `channel` and `routed`.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/whatsapp-official#meta-send

A contact card, in the QR-code shape (`contact`: `fullName`, `phone`, `organization`), which works on both channels.

Sozuri picks the channel (QR code or official) unless you pass `channel` (`qr` or `meta`) or `from` (one of your numbers). The response says which: `channel` and `routed`.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/whatsapp-official#meta-send

WhatsApp shows the message you are answering quoted above yours. `replyTo` is the id of a message in this chat; on the QR-code channel an id that is not in the chat is refused with `MESSAGE_NOT_FOUND`.

Sozuri picks the channel (QR code or official) unless you pass `channel` (`qr` or `meta`) or `from` (one of your numbers). The response says which: `channel` and `routed`.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/whatsapp-official#meta-send

An emoji reaction to a message in this chat. An empty `emoji` (`""`) removes your reaction, so `emoji` must always be present.

Sozuri picks the channel (QR code or official) unless you pass `channel` (`qr` or `meta`) or `from` (one of your numbers). The response says which: `channel` and `routed`.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/whatsapp-official#meta-send

A template Meta has approved: the only way to start a conversation on the official channel. `params.body` fills the template's variables in order. Official channel only.

Sozuri picks the channel (QR code or official) unless you pass `channel` (`qr` or `meta`) or `from` (one of your numbers). The response says which: `channel` and `routed`.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/whatsapp-official#meta-send

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/whatsapp-official#meta-send

item.name: QR-code channel
item.description:
The QR-code channel's own send endpoint. Same fields as the QR shape of `/v1/whatsapp/messages`.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/whatsapp-api

request.description:
Sends from the number linked by QR code.

Fields: `to` (international format, a WhatsApp id, or a group id ending `@g.us`), then `text` and/or one of `imageUrl`, `videoUrl`, `audioUrl` (`voice: true` for a voice note), `documentUrl` (+`documentFilename`), `stickerUrl`, `location`, `contact`, `reaction`. Optional `replyTo`, and `mentions` in a group.

Answer: `{"status":"sent","messageId":"…","to":"…","timestamp":"…"}`.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/whatsapp-api

response.name: No QR-code number linked

request.description:
An image from a public link, with `text` as its caption.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/whatsapp-api

item.name: Official channel
item.description:
The official channel's own send endpoint, in Meta's typed shape: `type` plus an object of the same name.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/whatsapp-official

request.description:
Sends from one of your official numbers (`from` picks one when you have several). Free-form text only inside the customer's 24-hour window; otherwise send a template.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/whatsapp-official

item.name: Templates
item.description:
Message templates exist on the official channel only. Only an `APPROVED` template can be sent.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/whatsapp-official#meta-templates

query.description: Optional: APPROVED, PENDING, REJECTED, PAUSED or DISABLED.

request.description:
Your templates and their review status. Up to 500.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/whatsapp-official#meta-templates

Submits a template for Meta's review.

- `name`: lower case letters, digits and underscores.
- `language`: e.g. `en`, `en_US`, `sw`.
- `category`: `marketing`, `utility` or `authentication`.
- `body.text` with numbered (`{{1}}`) or named variables, and `body.examples` for each.
- Optional `header`, `footer`, `buttons`; `waba_id` when your project has more than one WhatsApp Business Account.

**201** with the template, or **422** naming what to fix.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/whatsapp-official#meta-templates

item.name: Voice
item.description:
Place calls from your Sozuri voice number, read a one-time code over the phone, and look up calls. Voice errors come back with a 4xx status and a `code`; `201` means at least one call was placed.

Your project needs an active voice number (Project → Voice → Numbers).

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/voice

request.description:
Your numbers that are active, suspended or still being requested, and what answers each (`handlerType`). Only an `active` number can be `from`.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/voice#voice-numbers

Calls each number in `to` (a string, comma-separated, or an array; at most 100). When answered, the call does what your number is set to do in the dashboard (a message, a call flow, the call centre, a forward).

- `from`: optional, one of your active voice numbers.
- `tag`: optional, up to 60 characters, to filter calls later.

Numbers that could not be called come back in `rejected`. The test saves the first `callSid` in `{{callSid}}`.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/voice#voice-call

response.name: Balance too low
No voice number

request.description:
Calls one number and reads the code digit by digit, then repeats it. Never recorded; the code is not stored or returned.

- `code`: up to 12 characters; only digits are read.
- `brand`: optional name read before the code (default `Sozuri`).
- `repeat`: optional, 1 to 3 (default 2).
- `voice`: optional, e.g. `en-US-Standard-C` (default), `en-US-Standard-B`, `en-GB-Standard-A`, `en-GB-Standard-B`.
- `from`: optional, one of your active voice numbers.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/voice#voice-otp

One call with its timeline (`events`). Duration, price and recording are set when the call ends. `404 not_found` for a call that is not your project's.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/voice#voice-get

query.description: Optional: queued, ringing, in_progress, on_hold, completed, no_answer or failed.
Optional: calls whose tag starts with this.

request.description:
Your calls, newest first.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/voice#voice-list

item.name: Premium SMS
item.description:
Reverse-billed messages on Safaricom: the subscriber pays. **Subscription** services send on a schedule to people who opted in; **on-demand** services answer a request the subscriber texted, quoting its `linkId`.

The service is chosen by `keyword` (its activation keyword), or `premium_id`, or `from` (its shortcode).

Refusals are **HTTP 200** with `{"status":"error","description":"…"}`.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/subscription and https://sozuri.net/docs/ondemand

request.description:
Asks the network to subscribe the number. The answer is `pending`: the subscriber confirms on their phone, and your service's callback receives `activation` (or `consent`) when they do.

Refusals are **HTTP 200** with `{"status":"error","description":"…"}`.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/subscription

Ends the number's subscription. On success the subscriber is inactive at once.

Refusals are **HTTP 200** with `{"status":"error","description":"…"}`.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/subscription

Sends a subscription message to one active subscriber. The subscriber is charged per 160-character part.

Refusals are **HTTP 200** with `{"status":"error","description":"…"}`.

The `messageId` returned is the one your delivery callback reports.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/subscription

Answers a request a subscriber texted to your on-demand service. `linkId` comes from the `linkNotification` callback your service received; it is what authorises the charge.

Refusals are **HTTP 200** with `{"status":"error","description":"…"}`.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/ondemand

item.name: Contacts
item.description:
Your project's contacts. `mobile` is stored exactly as you send it.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/contacts

query.description: Optional: a group name. An unknown name returns every contact.

request.description:
Your contacts, 1,000 a page. The test saves the first contact's id in `{{contactId}}`.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/contacts

One contact, by id (or by the exact saved mobile). `404 {"error":"Contact not found"}` for one that is not your project's.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/contacts

Up to 1,000 contacts per call. `fname` and `mobile` (a string) are required; `mname`, `lname`, `email`, `city`, `company`, `job` are optional. `group` puts them in a group, created if it does not exist.

**201** `{"message":"Contacts created successfully"}`.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/contacts

Replaces the contact's fields: any field you leave out becomes empty. `fname` and `mobile` are required.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/contacts

Deletes the contact permanently.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/contacts

item.name: Payments
item.description:
Ask a customer to pay by M-Pesa from their phone (STK push), into your own paybill or till configured in the dashboard (Project → Payments → Configure). Confirmed payments reach the webhook URL set there.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/payments

request.description:
Sends the M-Pesa prompt to `phone`.

- `phone`: a string; its last 9 digits are prefixed with 254.
- `amount`: whole KES, at least 1.
- `account_reference`: optional, up to 12 characters; returned on the payment webhook as `BillRefNumber`.

Errors: 422 with `{"error":"…"}` (e.g. no paybill with prompt credentials on your project).

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/payments

response.name: Prompt sent
No paybill configured

item.name: Airtime (unavailable)
item.description:
**Airtime sending is not available right now.** The endpoint answers `503` with `data.status: "unavailable"` and nothing is sent or charged. The request is kept here so your integration is ready when it returns.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/airtime

request.description:
Currently answers **503**.

`recipients` is a **string** holding a JSON array of `{"number","amount"}`; amounts are whole KES, `"KES 10"`.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/airtime

response.name: Unavailable

item.name: Workflows
item.description: Start a published workflow that begins with a **Webhook** trigger. The workflow builder shows the trigger's URL token and signing secret; set `workflowHookToken` and `workflowWebhookSecret`.

request.description:
No API key: the request is authenticated by `X-Sozuri-Signature` over the raw body, which the pre-request script computes from `{{workflowWebhookSecret}}`. A signature older than 5 minutes, or used twice, is refused.

The body lands in the workflow as `{{webhook.<field>}}`. Add `to` (and `channel`: `sms` or `whatsapp`) when a step should message somebody.

- **200** `{"accepted":true,"started":1}`
- **403** `{"accepted":false,"code":"unauthorized",…}` for a wrong token or signature (they are deliberately indistinguishable)
- **409** `not_live` when the workflow is not published

item.name: Test your webhook receiver
item.description:
These requests do not call Sozuri. They POST the bodies Sozuri sends to **your** webhook URL, signed the same way, so you can build and test the receiving end before real traffic arrives.

To verify a real webhook: take the raw body, compute `HMAC-SHA256(signing secret, t + "." + raw body)` in lowercase hex, compare it with `v1` in `X-Sozuri-Signature` in constant time, and reject a `t` more than 5 minutes old. Answer 2xx within 8 seconds.

Docs: https://sozuri.net/docs/webhooks

request.description:
A delivery report for a message sent to a Safaricom number. `status` is `success`, `network_failure`, `delivery_impossible`, `absent_subscriber` or `unknown_error`. `timestamp` is when Sozuri sent the webhook.

Posts to **your** server (`{{yourWebhookUrl}}`), signed with `{{webhookSigningSecret}}` and carrying `{{webhookAuthKey}}` as the last field, exactly as Sozuri would. Copy both from Manage API → Callback URLs → Webhook security.

exec: // Builds the body exactly as Sozuri sends it, then signs it, so you can test your receiver.
// X-Sozuri-Signature: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(signing secret, "<t>.<raw body>")>
if (authKey) { payload.authKey = authKey; }        // always the LAST key, as Sozuri sends it

request.description:

request.description: A confirmed M-Pesa payment, as posted to the webhook URL of your paybill configuration. **Payment webhooks are not signed and carry no authKey.** Match them on `BillRefNumber`.

variable.description: The API base. Leave as is.
REQUIRED. Your project's API key: Manage API → API Credentials. Sent as a Bearer token on every request.
